description.zh: 在 Operit 原 QQ Bot 工具包（com.operit.qqbot_bundle）基础上补齐官方 v2 API 能力的增强包。独立安装、独立配置，不修改原包。能力：撤回消息、Markdown/引用/输入态发送、群信息/机器人群状态/机器人资料查询、增强版 Gateway（事件全放开 + 按钮回调回应）、自动回复桥（QQ→Operit→AI→QQ，合并自 qqbot-bridge-pro v1.0.0：C2C 绑定/群聚合/上下文缓存/持久化恢复/waifu 切分）。
description.en: An enhancement bundle over Operit's QQ Bot bundle, adding official v2 APIs. Independent install, does not modify the original bundle. Capabilities: recall, markdown/reference/input-notify sending, group info / bot state / bot profile queries, enhanced Gateway with all events, and auto-reply bridge (QQ→Operit→AI→QQ, merged from qqbot-bridge-pro v1.0.0).

display_name.zh: QQ Bot Pro 基础增强

description.zh: 撤回消息、Markdown/引用/输入态发送、群信息/群状态/机器人资料查询
description.en: Recall, markdown/reference/input-notify sending, group info / bot state / profile queries

display_name.zh: QQ Bot Pro 增强版 Gateway

description.zh: 事件全放开 Gateway（含按钮回调），独立端口 32146，与原包二选一
description.en: Enhanced Gateway with all events, port 32146, exclusive with original

display_name.zh: QQ Bot Pro 自动回复桥

description.zh: QQ 消息桥入 Operit 对话并回发 AI 回复（合并自 qqbot-bridge-pro v1.0.0）。C2C 按 openid 分对话/固定绑定、群按 group_openid 聚合、上下文环形缓存与当天恢复、并发 flush、waifu 切分、角色卡与 env 配置。
description.en: Bridge QQ messages into Operit chats and send AI replies back (merged from qqbot-bridge-pro v1.0.0). C2C per-openid chats/fixed bindings, group aggregation per group_openid, context ring cache with same-day recovery, concurrent flush, waifu flush, character card and env config.
